title: Information Geometry of Gradient Flows
summary: Taking classical information geometry as its point of departure, this paper investigates, through gradient flows, how dually flat geometry extends beyond regular convexity, non-degeneracy, and smoothness. The regular theory is developed from the log-determinant potential on positive definite Gram matrices, establishing its Legendre dual, Fisher--Rao metric, Bregman divergence, and generalized Pythagorean theorem. We connect this framework to Craig--Sakamoto deformation, Wolfe duality, and, via Yoshizawa's embedding, Brockett--Bloch--Ratiu double-bracket flows, linking isospectral dynamics,…
